description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wewala, Horana D/S Division, Kaluthara District - Cad. Map No. 530200 (22/1200095)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title registration, cadastral mapping, and determination of land ownership interests across multiple districts. The content focuses entirely on land administration and property rights, fitting the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
